messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Suspicious IDP token mirroring detected from edge-proxy -> analytics mirror stream. Detected duplicate session ids and raw id_token/access_token in forwarded payloads. Rule: idp-mirror-detector v2. Paging @sam_oncall.

sam_oncall: on it. pulling logs now. can we pause the mirror pipeline? @maria_ops can you disable the forwarder to analytics? :rotating_light:

maria_ops: disabling forwarder... running: ```./tools/logshipper disable --pipeline analytics-mirror``` done. seeing backlog in s3: s3://redwood-logs/edge-mirror/2026-03-17/...

jordan_sec: quick q — are tokens exfiltrated externally or mirrored internally only? any external destinations?

incident-bot: sample top src IPs: 54.203.11.22, 3.8.140.90. user agent hints: "kube-fluentd/1.13". sample token id: tok_7a9c... forwarded fields include id_token and access_token in plaintext.

sam_oncall: blocking those IPs at edge WAF now. ```aws wafv2 update-ip-set --addresses "54.203.11.22/32","3.8.140.90/32"``` done.

rajeev_eng: ASN lookup -> AS14618 (AWS). could be compromised forwarder or misconfigured worker. checking internal worker fleet.

lina_support: pulling affected-customer list from query logs: AcmeCorp, BlueWave, Medleaf. marking AcmeCorp & Medleaf high-risk.

jordan_sec: rotate SSO client secret + session signing key immediately. plan: dual-sign rollout for 10m to avoid breaking tokens. @sam_oncall coordinate.

sam_oncall: starting rotation. step1: generate new signing key -> ```gpg --gen-key --batch --passphrase-file /run/secret/pass``` step2: deploy new key as AUTH_SIGNING_KEY=v2 to auth-prod. will canary at 10%.

maria_ops: deployed new key to auth-prod-canary at 10%. canary logs show no JWT verification errors.

lina_support: drafting customer comms. recommended notify: AcmeCorp & Medleaf ASAP, BlueWave FYI. CS leads: @marcus_cc (pinged).

jordan_sec: revoke sessions issued between 2026-03-17T03:45Z and 2026-03-17T04:15Z. script: ```python tools/revoke_sessions.py --from 2026-03-17T03:45Z --to 2026-03-17T04:15Z``` Note: this will invalidate refresh tokens; prepare to help customers reauth.

sam_oncall: revoke job queued, ETA ~2m.

incident-bot: revoke job started (job id 98765) by sam_oncall. progress updates in thread.

maria_ops: revoke job finished. 1,204 sessions revoked. auth traffic normalized; 401 spike observed during revocation window.

jordan_sec: mirror pipeline archived objects contain raw tokens. need to preserve originals for forensics but restrict access and create sanitized copies. @maria_ops please coordinate S3 snapshot + sanitized copy + access lock.

maria_ops: starting sanitize+preserve workflow: copy originals to isolate bucket (s3://redwood-forensics/edge-mirror/2026-03-17/) restrict ACLs, then scrub working copy to s3://redwood-logs-sanitized/2026-03-17/. command: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/edge-mirror/2026-03-17/ s3://redwood-logs-sanitized/2026-03-17/ --recursive --metadata-directive REPLACE``` started.

lina_support: legal consulted? @emma_legal?

jordan_sec: DMed emma_legal — legal requests preservation + limited access for forensics. do not delete originals until legal signs off.

sam_oncall: mitigation: push log redaction at proxy side to drop access_token/id_token/refresh_token fields before sending to mirror. patch pushed to canary.

rajeev_eng: patch: remove-fields regex 'access_token|id_token|refresh_token' in fluentd filter. deploying.

maria_ops: redaction applied in canary; verified sanitized entries no longer contain token fields. rolling out globally now.

jordan_sec: action items (quick): 1) add config linting for logshipper configs, 2) enforce PII scrub at source for mirror pipelines, 3) least-privilege IAM for analytics readers, 4) retention review for mirrored logs. will author full RCA.

sam_oncall: handoff: I'll remain on rotation for 30m to confirm rollouts. @jordan_sec will own sec RCA and compliance notifications.

lina_support: tickets opened: INC-4521 (AcmeCorp), INC-4522 (Medleaf), INC-4523 (BlueWave). CS leads notified; drafting comms for approval.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mirror stream paused, suspect IPs blocked, keys rotated, sessions revoked, sanitized copies created and originals locked for forensics. Followups: RCA, legal review, config linting, and improved redaction. Posting summary to #sec-updates. :white_check_mark:
